**James Washington**  
**Wide Receiver**  
**Oklahoma State**  
**5-11, 213**  
**Stamford, Texas**  
**Stamford High School**  
**2nd Round â 60th Overall**

CAREER NOTES**  
Set an Oklahoma State record with 4,472 receiving yards â second-most in Big 12 historyâ¦his career totals of 4,472 receiving yards and 39 touchdown receptions both led all FBS players active in 2017â¦career average of 85.9 receiving yards per game was the best among all receivers from Power Five conferences (minimum 2,000 career receiving yards)â¦is one of two players in school history with three seasons of at least 1,000 receiving yards and three seasons with at least 10 touchdown catches, joining Rashaun Woods.

2017 SEASON**  
Biletnikoff Award â nation's top receiver â recipientâ¦unanimous All-America and All-Big 12 selectionâ¦led the nation with 1,549 receiving yards and 119.2 receiving yards per gameâ¦had nine 100-yard games, highlighted by six catches, 235 yards and one touchdown vs. Baylorâ¦had three multi-touchdown games...his 1,549 receiving yards ranked as the third-best total in school history...voted a team captain.

**2016 SEASON**  
Earned first-team All-Big 12 honors for the first time after totaling a second-best mark in the conference with 1,380 receiving yardsâ¦earned national Offensive Player of the Week honors from Walter Camp Football Foundation following a 296-receiving yard performance on nine catches and two touchdowns vs. Pittsburghâ¦led all FBS players with a 19.44 yards per catch average (minimum 70 receptions)â¦voted a team captain.

2015 SEASON**  
Second-team All-Big 12 selectionâ¦led the nation with four 70-plus yard receptions and ranked 10th nationally with a 20.5 yards per catch averageâ¦totaled 1,087 receiving yards and 10 touchdown catchesâ¦had five 100-yard games and finished second on the team with 53 catchesâ¦scored touchdowns on four consecutive touches (75, 73, 48 and 50 yards) in wins over Texas Tech and TCUâ¦named Big 12 Offensive Player of the Week after posting a then career-high 200 receiving yards vs. Texas Tech.

**2014 SEASON**  
Led the team with six touchdown catches, a total that ranked fourth nationally among freshmenâ¦finished eighth in the Big-12 with a 16.3 yards per catch averageâ¦tallied with 28 catches for 456 yards.

**HIGH SCHOOL**
